scope: Official product identity, entry points, operator requirements and release boundaries; not a runtime grant or verification receipt.

commitments.external_costs: Optional third-party services, hardware and provider usage retain their own disclosed costs.
operator_requirements: Use each operator's own identity, accounts, data, ArcheAgents and permitted connections.
Preserve independent information and permissions; the shared entry does not share private state or authority.
Retain reusable profile, identity, memory, agent, recovery, accessibility and developer mechanisms where implemented.
Exclude operator-specific instances, private data, credentials and configuration from public packages.

official_release_owner.community_contributions: Existing issue and pull-request process; participation does not itself grant access.
official_release_owner.downstream_rights: Governed by the applicable license, separately from official project decisions.

release_boundaries.native_application: Continue existing native application and shared runtime; qualify each platform package.
release_boundaries.provider_connections: Continue existing adapters; qualify each provider or device through its own permitted connection.
release_boundaries.public_repository_contents: Documentation and community materials; standalone runtime source not released.
release_boundaries.signed_customer_packages: Per-platform measured state in docs/release-artifacts.json; existing installed applications are preserved.

account_model.account_resolution: Existing identity and Membership owners bind verified provider identity to the native principal, permitted account/World memberships and registered resources. Email text, role names and plugin titles are not grants.
account_model.existing_account_continuity: Preserve established state, identity, fleet registrations and source lineage when adopting or updating the common product.
account_model.new_account_setup: Establish operator-owned state and enroll nodes through the same product mechanisms.
account_model.distribution_boundary: Exclude private records, credentials and account bindings from public package defaults while retaining reusable capabilities.
account_model.current_package_split: Platform builds and account-specific configuration of the same master application; no separate product or founder feature tier.

profile_and_sources.profile_owner: Existing authenticated identity, World, memory and source owners.
profile_and_sources.populated_state: Each account retains its own accumulated context, history, roles and permitted resource references.
profile_and_sources.repository_selection: One or many operator-selected repositories within the actual provider connection's grants; repository count is not a product edition.
profile_and_sources.shared_connector_contract: Reuse the common service contract across supported authenticated chat-client transports; verify each client's provider access separately.
profile_and_sources.customer_derivation: Preserve common product code and capabilities; replace account-specific defaults and bindings with the new operator's own profile and permissions.
